name: claude-code-mate
description: Local Web UI for managing multiple concurrent Claude Code CLI sessions across collaboration roles (planA-R / planA-H / execB / testC) on Windows.
author: Claude Code Mate contributors

scripts.syntax-check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); function walk(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name); if(e.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if(p.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execSync('node --check \"'+p+'\"');}} walk('server'); walk('probe'); walk('tests'); console.log('all .js files parse OK');"
